research.facts:
LLSWS Grand Final — North Carolina vs. Kentucky
**Sources:** MLB.com, Bleacher Report, Yahoo Sports, Salisbury Post, Little League official site, The Owensboro Times
**Key Facts (HIGH confidence):**
- Grand Final: **North Carolina vs. Kentucky**, Sunday August 9 at **3 PM ET on ABC**, Stallings Stadium (Elm Street Park), Greenville, NC
- NC represents Southeast Region — **Johnston County Little League**, Clayton, NC
- KY represents Central Region — **Daviess County Little League**, Owensboro, KY
- **Orange Bracket Championship (Aug 8):** Kentucky 2, New Jersey 1
- Go-ahead hit: **Evelyn Chelstrom** lined a two-out RBI single in the 5th inning, scoring Michaela Knight
- KY held on to win by one run
- **Purple Bracket Championship (Aug 8):** North Carolina 4, Florida 0
- **Anna-Lynn Clark** pitched complete-game shutout, **11 strikeouts**
- Clark now has **35 total tournament strikeouts** — leading all LLSWS pitchers
- This was her **third game this tournament with 11+ strikeouts**
- NC is chasing its **4th LLSWS title** (previous championships: 2015, 2019, 2024)
- Grand Final result: **NOT YET CONFIRMED** (game at 3 PM ET — may not have occurred at time of research)
**MEDIUM confidence:**
- Anna-Lynn Clark described as dominant performer of the tournament across multiple sources
**Notes:**
- Championship result will not be in today's pipeline — writing as preview/today's game
- Follow up tomorrow if needed to capture result

- Wave of commitment announcements expected immediately after Sept 1

research.facts:
USA Women's National Team
**Sources:** USA Softball official, WBSC official
**Key Facts (HIGH confidence):**
- Event: **WBSC Softball Women's World Cup Group Stage** — Oklahoma City group (Group C)
- Dates: **September 12-16, 2026** — **34 days from today (Aug 9)**
- Venue: **Devon Park, Oklahoma City**
- USA world ranking: **No. 2** (Japan is No. 1)
- Head coach: **Patty Gasso**
- **Group C opponents:**
- Netherlands (No. 6)
- Mexico (No. 7)
- China (No. 8)
- New Zealand (No. 23)
- South Africa (No. 36)
- USA opens vs. **Mexico** on Sept. 12 (final game of opening day)
- Round-robin runs through Sept. 15; Play-Offs on Sept. 16
- **Key roster players:** Rachel Garcia, Dejah Mulipola, Montana Fouts, Maya Brady
- Roster: 7 athletes from 2025 World Games gold squad; 10 from 2025 USA Down Under Series
- OKC event is part of 3-city group stage (Prague June 16-20 completed; Lima July 14-18 completed; OKC is final group)
- Results feed into **2027 World Cup qualification** and **LA28 Olympic pipeline**
- Patty Gasso quote: "This is an outstanding group of athletes, and the depth of talent in our program continues to grow... I'm excited to see what we can accomplish together as we chase gold this fall."
